title: Staff Applications
description: A simple and efficient staff application plugin that links players directly to your server’s official staff application form for quick and easy access.
body:
**StaffApps – Staff Application**

StaffApps keeps your community informed with automatic staff‑recruitment reminders and a simple /staff command that delivers your application link. Java players get a clickable link, while Bedrock (via Geyser/Floodgate) receives a copyable URL.

**Features**

Automatic reminders every 30 minutes (configurable).
/staff command sends the application link.
Java: clickable URL.
Bedrock: plain link for easy copy.
Optional join reminder with a delay.
In‑game reload.

PaperMC 1.21.11
Geyser/Floodgate supported (soft dependency)

**Commands**


```
/staff
```



```
/staff reload
```


**Permissions**


```
staffapps.use
```



```
staffapps.reload
```
